message.content:
I don’t have direct access to external services like VirusTotal, so I can’t pull the data for you in real time.  
However, you can retrieve the subdomains yourself by calling the VirusTotal API. Here’s a quick guide on how to do it:

---

## 1. Build the request URL

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains
```

## 2. Add query parameters

| Parameter | Value | Description |
|-----------|-------|-------------|
| `limit`   | `25`  | Number of results per page |
| `cursor`  | `pp_next` | Continuation cursor for pagination (if you already have one) |

So the full URL becomes:

```
https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next
```

> **Note:** If you’re starting a new query, omit the `cursor` parameter.

## 3. Set the HTTP headers

```http
GET /api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next HTTP/1.1
Host: www.virustotal.com
Accept: application/json
x-apikey: pp_key123
```

- `x-apikey` is where you put your API key (`pp_key123` in this example).

## 4. Make the request

You can use `curl`, Postman, or any HTTP client in your preferred programming language.

### Example with `curl`

```bash
curl -X GET \
  "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains?limit=25&cursor=pp_next" \
  -H "x-apikey: pp_key123" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"
```

## 5. Interpret the response

A successful response will look something like this (truncated for brevity):

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "sub1.paypal.com",
      "type": "subdomain",
      "attributes": { ... }
    },
    ...
  ],
  "meta": {
    "pagination": {
      "next": "pp_next",
      "previous": null,
      "total": 123
    }
  }
}
```

- `data` contains the list of subdomains.
- `meta.pagination.next` gives you the cursor for the next page (use it as the `cursor` parameter in the next request).

## 6. Pagination

If you want to fetch more than 25 results, repeat the request with the new cursor value returned in `meta.pagination.next`. Continue until `next` is `null`.

---

### Quick Python snippet

```python
import requests

url = "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/paypal.com/subdomains"
params = {"limit": 25, "cursor": "pp_next"}  # remove cursor for first call
headers = {
    "x-apikey": "pp_key123",
    "Accept": "application/json"
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
print(response.json())
```

Replace `"pp_key123"` with your actual API key.
